A member of the Explorer Society got lost while investigating the amazon camp north of Venore. This page covers two quests very close together: at Witch Hill, two boxes hold the {item:Skull of Ratha}, a {item:White Pearl}, a {item:Wolf Tooth Chain} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}; in the cellar of the witches' house, a chest holds 100 gp, a {item:Crystal Necklace} and 2 {item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls}. The only difficulty is defeating the guards.
A member of the Explorer Society tried to find out more about the Amazon camp near Venore and got lost.
Witch Hill, amazon camp (north of Venore)
Recommended minimum levels and skills for the camp: Knights level 9 with skills 45/40; Paladins level 9 with distance 40; mages level 7.

The {creature:Witch|Witches} cast {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields} that can block your way: a {item:Destroy Field Rune} solves it.
Watch out for Witches lured by other players.
Do not throw away the {item:Skull of Ratha}: it is worth 250 gp at the Explorer Society.

From Venore, cross the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} (between Venore and Kazordoon) to the Amazon camp ({wiki:Amazon Camp (Venore)|Amazon Camp}), a little **northwest** of Venore. In the swamp use the {item:Machete} on the {item:Jungle Grass} that blocks the way and bring antidotes: there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}. The camp also has an entrance in the **north**, over a bridge.
The "Witch Hill" is near the centre of the camp.
Location of the Witch Hill in the Amazon camp
Kill the 2 {creature:Witch|Witches}, the 3 {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries} and the 2 {creature:Lion|Lions} that guard the place.
The Witches cast Fire Fields; if the way gets blocked use a Destroy Field Rune.
Open the two boxes. You receive two bags: one with a {item:White Pearl} and the {item:Skull of Ratha}, and another with a {item:Wolf Tooth Chain} and a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Take the {item:Skull of Ratha} to a post of the {wiki:Explorer Society}, in **Northport** or **Port Hope**, and trade it for a 250 gp reward.
2. Witch house cave (Crystal Necklace and Black Pearls)
Go down through the witch house
This part is underground, **east** of the Witch Hill. Go down the stairs of the "Witch house" (the purple mark on the map) and follow the cave map to the reward.
Map of the cave beneath the witch house
The chest is guarded by 1 {creature:Witch} and 3 to 5 {creature:Valkyrie|Valkyries}. Kill them.
Open the chest: it has a bag with 100 gp, a {item:Crystal Necklace} and 2 {item:Black Pearl|Black Pearls}.
Leave the cave and return to Venore

Go back along the path on the cave map to the stairs and climb to the witch house, on the surface of the camp. Then leave the camp the same way you came: **southeast** through the {wiki:Green Claw Swamp} to Venore (or over the bridge in the **north**).
If the way is blocked by {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields}, use the {item:Destroy Field Rune}.
